Electrical submetering systems

One load or an entire building.

A submetering system brings together meters, compatible current sensors, communications and software. Start with the loads you want to measure and the reports your team needs.

Panel-mounted

Socomec DIRIS A-40

Power and energy metering for panel doors and equipment. Pair the selected version with compatible Socomec current sensors and the communications your system needs.

Product details & documentation
Enclosed metering

Socomec DIRIS DigiBOX A

An enclosed single-circuit submetering option with a display. A practical starting point for monitoring an individual feeder, tenant or equipment load.

Product details & documentation
16 / 48current sensor inputs
Tenant & multiple-load metering

Socomec DIRIS MCM

Measure multiple tenants, departments or equipment loads with one enclosed metering system. DIRIS MCM offers 16 or 48 current sensor inputs and supports compatible 333 mV CTs or Rogowski sensors for submetering and retrofit projects.

The number of loads depends on their phase configuration. Tenant billing requirements should be confirmed for the project.
